summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the Raquel tribute site on the public preview URL. All 4 sections (Hero, Journey, Music, Story), navigation, progress bar, footer, fonts, assets, and animations verified on desktop (1920x800) and mobile (390x844). Site fully functional — no blockers.
passed: Page loads without JS console errors or page errors
All Nav testIDs visible: site-nav, nav-logo, nav-link-hero/journey/music/story
Hero: hero-section, hero-image (background-image with heroAdult URL), hero-title, hero-subtitle, hero-scroll-hint all visible on first fold
Second hero act: hero-mini-polaroid and hero-intro exist and become visible after scroll
Journey: journey-section, journey-title, and journey-step-0/1/2 exist; steps animate from opacity 0 -> 1 correctly when scrolled via wheel (Lenis + ScrollTrigger)
Music: music-section, music-title, music-marquee, and music-card-0..5 all present and animate in on scroll
Story: story-section, story-title, story-chapter-0/1/2, story-lucas-reveal, story-letter all present and animate in on scroll
Progress bar: .progress-bar element fixed top:0, height 2px, linear-gradient(90deg, #7c3aed, #fb923c, #fde047), scaleX transform grows with scroll
Footer visible with text 'R·raquel ... Um site — feito com muito amor por Lucas! ... 04 atos · 01 pessoa ... © 2026 — sempre pra você'
Fonts: hero-title & subtitle computed fontFamily = 'Fraunces, "Playfair Display", serif' — Fraunces loaded (no default sans fallback)
Assets: heroAdult (xkmp9w1x_image.png) and miniRaquel (r71kvi7s_image.png) both return HTTP 200
No horizontal overflow on desktop 1920x800 or mobile 390x844
Smooth scroll via Lenis works when clicking nav links AND when using mouse wheel; ScrollTrigger reveal animations fire correctly
notes: Initial checks with element.scrollIntoView() showed nested testIDs (journey-step-*, music-card-*, story-chapter-*) as visibility:hidden/opacity:0 — this is expected GSAP initial state. Using mouse.wheel() to trigger real scroll events resolves it and all reveal animations play correctly. Not a bug. One transient ERR_ABORTED for hero image was seen on initial load but image ultimately renders and HEAD request returns 200. Cloudflare /cdn-cgi/rum abort is unrelated Emergent template noise.
